text.tspan: Remote backend: one shared, locked, encrypted, versioned state
plan on MR, apply on main
block public access · bucket policy = CI role only
(exists only while someone holds the lock)
Local state problems: lost laptop = lost state, two applies at once = corrupt state, secrets on disk, no history.
Remote: shared truth + locking + encryption + versions to recover from. GitLab also offers GitLab-managed Terraform state (http backend).
